meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后，每次编辑类调用成功后会自动跑一次注释检查；如果检查器报警，Claude 会收到阻断性反馈，需要先修正或解释被标记的注释再往下做。
howto.when: 在 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类调用成功之后触发；非编辑类工具不触发，缺少检查器程序时也不产生输出。

say.text: 刚才注释检查报警了，先把那条被标记的注释修好
say.note: 会被当作阻断性反馈处理

say.text: 解释一下这条注释为什么被 comment-checker 标记
say.note: 按反馈给出解释而非直接改动

say.text: 这条注释保持原样，说明为什么可以不改
say.note: Codex 会说明理由再继续

howto.what_en: Once installed, a successful edit-style call triggers a comment check; if comment-checker warns, Codex gets blocking feedback and should fix or explain the flagged comment before moving on.
howto.when_en: Runs after a successful edit-style call (apply_patch, write, edit, etc.) when the checker reports a warning; non-edit tools are ignored and a missing checker binary emits no output.

say_en.text: The comment check just warned - fix the flagged comment first
Explain why comment-checker flagged this comment
Leave this comment as is and explain why
say_en.note: Codex gives a reason, then continues
